purpose: a post-finder refinement of the GRAD line finder's boxes (runtime/vocr_lines_refine.c) to close the gap between the console finder's crop and the hand-cut ink crop on dialogue; no retraining

api: vocr_refine_lines(im, flags, arena, bytes, set, rows_read)
vocr_refine_lines_rows(src, flags, arena, bytes, set, rows_read)
refinement.off: flags 0 returns the finder's set unchanged (bit-identical; tested)
refinement.arena: vocr_refine_arena_bytes(w, h) <= vocr_lines_arena_bytes(w, h): the finder's arena serves both

selection.data: development only: the five cohorts below; no protected set was read before this freeze
selection.how: about 80 configurations of 10 prototypes (scratch, not committed) were compared on all five cohorts with all six arms; the frozen rule is the configuration with the lowest mean pairs-dialogue CER among those no worse on mean whole-dialogue CER at any variant; ablation of its flags recorded in docs/finder-tighten.md

cohort_rules: eval/finder_tighten.py cohorts (module docstring): pairs = devnative v3 select-pool and owner pool v2 lines with a clean GRAD crop and an ink crop; whole dialogue = labelled non-name lines grouped (gap <= 1.6 line heights) + 12/6 px, then +0/+4/+8 px, other text boxes kept out

primary: pairs dialogue CER: dn_pairs + own_pairs non-name lines, GRAD crop vs refined crop (ink crop as the floor); dn_pairs alone gives the 'gap closed' share
whole-dialogue CER: tv_dlg + own_dlg + dn_dlg frames not in teacher_val (never pooled twice), per variant and pooled over base/+4/+8
metrics.scoring: metrics.norm, Levenshtein; whole dialogue by train/general_vn_textbox_guard.transcript_score (all text; the regions hold no name); C finder + C refinement + C runtime W8I (scalar build)
metrics.intervals: paired bootstrap over units and over VN clusters (eval/vocr3_report), 10,000 reps, seed 0, at least 5 VNs

sets.vita-test, psp-test: eval's whole-dialogue regions (vocr3_report.dialogue_regions; regions with an uncertain line left out whole) at base/+4/+8: GRAD vs GRAD + refinement, all six arms; body (dialogue) scope primary, all text secondary; fixed lines use no finder and are unchanged
sets.CLANNAD: owner-drive-ingest's frozen Claude references (refs_sha256 35411688749b2968b4b47306b65475503644c0bfa1ea8eba0b30885fe4a6212b): each page's ROI from its native frame, the C finder, every scored line's finder box read as it is and refined (its refined lines joined), all six arms; clannad_refs scoring and whole-page bootstraps

protected.attempt_records: protected.attempt.json and clannad.attempt.json, created exclusively (a second run refuses)
protected.disclosure: VOCR4-W20 (arm M) trained on the owner's planetarian PSP frames (Key/Prototype, like CLANNAD's Vita port): its CLANNAD numbers carry that exposure (owner rule 2026-10-13; docs/vocr4.md)
